tour.step1.body: Inventory shows your tradable items and current warframe.market prices. Click a card to view orders or list the item.
tour.step10.body: Relics can show your collection or the full catalog. Search by reward, find relics with unowned items, and compare expected value.
tour.step11.body: View and manage your warframe.market orders here. Completed trades can close matching orders automatically.
tour.step13.body: Use these tabs for unveiled Rivens, veiled Rivens, and Riven Finder. Click an owned Riven to see its grades. Riven Finder searches market listings by weapon and stats.
tour.step14.body: Arbitration and Profit-Taker runs are recorded automatically. Open a run for details or import an EE.log file.
tour.step15.body: Search for an item to see where it drops.
tour.step16.body: Configure the relic, Riven, trade, and arbitration overlays here.
tour.step3.body: Foundry shows builds you can start, builds in progress, and items ready to claim. Pinned recipes stay at the top.
tour.step4.body: Mastery tracks your rank progress and the items you have not mastered.
tour.step7.body: Stats tracks resources and trades detected in EE.log. You can also import AlecaFrame history.
tour.step8.body: World shows cycles, fissures, invasions, bounties, and Circuit rotations. Cycle alerts are optional.

setup.finish.settings: Everything here can be redone under Settings > Help.
help.title: Help
help.tourDesc: Walk through the main views again.
help.setupDesc: Inventory source, warframe.market sign-in, look and overlays.
help.placementDesc: Drag the overlays to where you want them over the game.
help.communityDesc: Ask questions and share ideas in the project discussions.
help.issueDesc: Opens a new GitHub issue. Nothing is sent from the app itself.
inventory.stale: Your game synced its inventory since your last import. Re-import for exact counts.
inventory.passiveTracks: Passive mode keeps this inventory current with your trades and the relic rewards you pick. Mission rewards and the Missions view need memory mode.
inventory.pill.openSettings: Click to manage the inventory source.
inventory.importHint: Import an inventory JSON, or drop the file on this window.
inventory.dropHint: No inventory yet. Import a file or drop it on this window.
inventory.basedOn: Based on your inventory import from {date}.
inventory.basedOnDeltas: Trades and relic picks since then are included (picks are estimates).
settings.profileIdHelp: Used for your public profile (owned equipment, mastery). Sign in at warframe.com, then paste your profile link or the 24-character account ID (the value of the "gid" cookie, in your browser's developer tools). In passive mode CompanionFrame never reads it from the game.
settings.profileIdInvalid: No valid account ID found. It has 24 characters (0-9, a-f).
settings.profileIdSaved: Saved. Clear the field and save to remove it.
setup.downloadFailedConnection: Download failed. Check your internet connection.
setup.downloading.title: Downloading...
titlebar.tooltip.accessDenied: Warframe appears to run as administrator, so CompanionFrame cannot read it. Restart the game without admin rights.
titlebar.tooltip.memoryBlocked: Linux blocks CompanionFrame from reading Warframe's memory (kernel.yama.ptrace_scope). Run "sudo sysctl kernel.yama.ptrace_scope=0" to allow it until the next reboot; the README's Linux section shows how to keep it.
titlebar.tooltip.gameNotRunning: Start Warframe and log in. Data is fetched automatically.
titlebar.tooltip.notLoggedIn: Warframe is running but not logged in. Data loads automatically about a minute after login.
titlebar.tooltip.tokenNotFound: Warframe is logged in but the login token was not found in game memory. Restart the game; if this keeps happening, report it on Discord.
dashboard.lastMission.none: No mission recorded yet. Finish a mission and what you got shows up here.
dashboard.lastMission.reading: Reading what the last mission brought...
dashboard.lastMission.readFailed: The inventory could not be read from the game after the last mission. Its rewards show up with the next inventory sync or mission.
dashboard.lastMission.missionCount: Covers {count} missions because earlier reads failed.
dashboard.lastMission.hint: Everything the inventory gained since it was last read before the mission, so trades, foundry claims and purchases in between can count too.
dashboard.lastMission.noFreshCopy: No inventory from after the mission was found in the game's memory.
settings.missionsDesc: Reads the inventory copy the game already keeps in memory after each mission, the same way AlecaFrame does.
dashboard.lastMission.trackingOff: Mission tracking is off, so no missions are recorded.
missions.ducatValueHint: The ducat values of everything received, added up
dataSource.title: Data source
dataSource.passive.name: Passive
dataSource.memory.name: Game memory (warframe-api-helper)
dataSource.disclaimer: This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Digital Extremes. Using tools that read game client memory may violate the Warframe Terms of Service and could result in action against your account. You use this software at your own risk.
dataSource.consent: I have read this and accept the risk.
dataSource.passive.gets: Your inventory from AlecaFrame, a file or your public profile, kept current by your trades and the relic rewards you pick.
dataSource.passive.risk: Lower. Nothing reads the game's memory; the general third-party risk still applies.
dataSource.memory.gets: A full, fresh inventory on every sync, plus the Missions view.
dataSource.memory.needs: warframe-api-helper (installed from here) and your consent.
dataSource.memory.risk: Reads the game's memory, which may break the Warframe Terms of Service.
dataSource.memory.next: Once it is enabled, install the helper here, run it now and choose whether it syncs on its own.
dataSource.sources.title: Where your inventory comes from
dataSource.sources.desc: Use any one of these. Trades in EE.log and the relic rewards you pick (screen OCR) keep it current.
dataSource.aleca.name: AlecaFrame cache (lastData.dat)
dataSource.aleca.found: Found in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AlecaFrame. Load it once and it updates whenever AlecaFrame saves.
dataSource.aleca.missing: Not found in %LOCALAPPDATA%\AlecaFrame. Browse to it if AlecaFrame keeps it somewhere else.
dataSource.aleca.inUse: Loaded. It updates whenever AlecaFrame saves.
dataSource.json.name: Inventory file (inventory.json)
dataSource.json.desc: Choose the file, or drop it anywhere on this window.
app.disclaimer: CompanionFrame is a third-party tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Digital Extremes. DE does not officially approve third-party software and reserves the right to act against tools it considers suspicious. You use this software at your own risk.
app.license: CompanionFrame is free software under the {license}, provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. Its authors are not responsible for any consequence of using it, including action against your account.
overlayGuide.reward.caption: When your squad opens relics: the highlighted box sits just above the four reward cards; the dashed outline is what gets scanned.
overlayGuide.reward.alt: Relic reward screen with four reward cards in a row, outlined as the scanned area; the overlay sits in the band just above them.
overlayGuide.riven.caption: While you reroll a riven: the highlighted box in the top-right corner; the dashed outline is the card that gets read. It opens by itself on the cycle screen; the riven rescan key (F6 by default) reads it again.
overlayGuide.riven.alt: Riven mod screen with one card in the middle outlined as the scanned area; the overlay sits in the top-right corner, clear of the card.
overlayGuide.arbi.caption: During an arbitration: the highlighted box in the top-right corner, clear of the mission objective.
overlayGuide.arbi.alt: Mission screen with the objective at top left and abilities at bottom right; the overlay sits in the top-right corner.
overlayGuide.trade.caption: After a trade completes: the highlighted box in the bottom-right corner.
overlayGuide.trade.alt: Trade window with two offer panels; the overlay sits in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
settings.hotkeysHint: Move overlays shows every overlay with sample content over the game: drag each one where you want it, then press the key again or click Done. The scan keys read the reward screen or a riven card again; the riven panels also open by themselves on the cycle screen.
settings.moveOverlaysHint: Shows them all over the game to drag into place. In game: {hotkey}.
settings.saveScanCapturesHint: Keeps the last 20 reward and riven scan images, with the text read from them, in the log folder (logs/scans). Nothing is uploaded: send them yourself if you report a misread.
settings.profileFetchFailed: Could not fetch the public profile. Check the ID and your connection; CompanionFrame retries every few hours.
settings.profileFetchedAt: Profile loaded {time}. Mastery uses it while no inventory is imported.
overlay.riven.scopeTopTwo: Matched on the top 2 buffs only
overlay.riven.reasonWait: Verdict appears once both cards are read.
overlay.riven.unreadText: Keep the cursor off the card for a moment, then read again.
overlay.riven.medianNote: Estimate from the {weapon} weapon median ({count} listings). Treat it as a floor, not a price.
diag.desc: Support tools: EE.log tail, OCR, game window and the last reward scan. Copy the text into a GitHub issue.
diag.scanHint: Open a relic reward screen in game, then run the scan debug.
update.installing: Installing, the app restarts by itself...
update.autoDesc: On start and every 6 hours the app asks github.com whether a newer version exists. Nothing about you is sent.
